name: Contextual Filter Referer
description: Two Views argument-default plugins that resolve a contextual filter value from the referring page's URL, so context survives Views' AJAX endpoint.
project_description: This project aims to be the solution for applying contextual filters to views that are executed during AJAX requests, such as entity reference fields that are filtered by a view. Just enable the module, and use one of the two options provided, just as you would their counterparts. These options get the necessary data from the referer URL in the headers, rather than the current URL. It is a full project created from an unmaintained sandbox project (swilmes/3204196).
